name: Heat Index Wednesday Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 6:00 pm, from the NOMA circle in City Park. About 15 miles around City Park and along the lakefront.

start_location.name: NOMA Circle, City Park
start_location.address: 1 Collins Diboll Circle, New Orleans, LA 70125

host.name: Heat Index Wednesday Ride (on the NOLA Social Ride calendar)

visitor_notes: Meet at the NOMA circle at 6 pm. The ride is for women, trans and nonbinary riders, in the host's words.
description: A no-drop Wednesday evening ride for the women, trans and nonbinary cycling community, in the host's own words. It runs the usual 15-mile loop around City Park and along the lakefront at 13 to 15 mph. The group keeps everyone together.
evidence: NOLA Social Ride's event calendar lists Heat Index Wednesday Ride for Wed Oct 7, 14, 21 and 28, 2026 at 6:00 pm from NOMA Circle: 'a NO DROP ride meant for the women, trans, and nonbinary cycling community' (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Read the WordPress Events Calendar feed (?ical=1) on nolasocialride.org; it lists the next weeks of this ride.

name: NOLA Fixed Wednesday Night Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, meet 7:00 pm, roll out 7:45 pm from the Cabrini Bridge.
visitor_notes: The calendar gives only the start, not the distance or pace. Check the group's Facebook page for changes.
description: A weekly night ride for fixed-gear riders, listed on the New Orleans social-ride calendar. The group meets at 7 pm and rolls out at 7:45 pm from the Cabrini Bridge.
evidence: NOLA Social Ride's event calendar lists NOLA Fixed Wednesday Night Ride for Wed Oct 7, 14, 21 and 28, 2026: 'NOLA Fixed meets at 7 and rolls out at 7:45pm from the Cabrini Bridge' (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

name: Critical Mass NOLA
schedule: Last Friday of the month: meet 6:00 pm, roll 6:30 pm from the French Market, Barracks Street side.

start_location.name: French Market, Barracks Street side
start_location.address: 1008 N Peters St, New Orleans, LA 70116

visitor_notes: Volunteer-led and informal; riders are responsible for their own safety, per the group. Check the NOLA Social Ride calendar for the exact week.
description: A monthly volunteer-led community ride that gathers at the French Market. In its own words it is informal, and riders are responsible for their own safety. The same group runs the Oct 13 Fete Ghisallo procession and blessing of the bikes from the same spot.
evidence: NOLA Social Ride's ride list (page with Oct 2026 events) says 'Last Friday monthly: Critical Mass; meet @ 6pm, roll @ 6:30 from French Market, Barracks side', and its calendar added Critical Mass NOLA's Fete Ghisallo (Tue Oct 13, 2026, same meeting point) on Sept 25, 2026 (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

name: Callaghan's Tuesday Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:15 pm, from Callaghan's Irish Social Club. A, B and C groups.
pace: A 20+ mph, B 16–20, C 14–16 (groups pending attendance)
visitor_notes: The club allows one free try-out ride (a single-event waiver is required, valid seven days); after that riders are expected to join. It is mainly a road-bike club, and the club says mountain bikes will not keep the pace.
description: A standing club ride from Callaghan's. The club splits into A, B and C groups depending on who shows up, and the C group is no-drop. The calendar says it can be spirited or casual depending on attendance.
evidence: Mobile Bay Riders Cycling Club's Google Calendar (edited Sept 18, 2026) has a weekly Tuesday series 'Callaghan's Ride, 6:15 pm; A 20+, B 16-20, C 14-16mph Groups' that began Jan 13, 2026 and has no end date (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Mobile Bay Riders' public Google Calendar (info@mobilebayrcc.org) lists a weekly series; read it for the next dates and any cancelled ones. Club Facebook group posts weekly details.

name: Greer's Market Sunday Ride

pace: Group 1 averages 17+ mph; group 2 averages 15–16 mph
visitor_notes: The club allows one free try-out ride (a single-event waiver is required, valid seven days); after that riders are expected to join. It is mainly a road-bike club, and the club says mountain bikes will not keep the pace.
description: The club's Sunday morning ride from downtown Mobile. It splits into two groups, a 17-plus mph group and a 15 to 16 mph group, over about 30 miles, with extensions available.

name: DCBC Wednesday Ladies Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday: the 24-mile ride starts 5:30 pm from Parker-Haun Park; the 16-mile option starts 5:45–5:50 pm from the Army Corps of Engineers maintenance lot. No-drop.
visitor_notes: Check the club's GroupMe (link on the club's home page) for the week's details. The club says it is a registered USA Cycling club; joining is $25 a year, and the shop that lists its rides calls them members only, so ask about a first ride.
description: A no-drop ride for women of all experience levels that Beth Mitchell founded in 2016 inside the Druid City Bicycle Club. There is a 24-mile ride and a shorter 16-mile ride that starts a few minutes later from a different lot.
evidence: Druid City Bicycle Club's home page lists the Wednesday Ladies Ride (24 miles 5:30 pm from Parker-Haun Park, 16-mile option 5:45-5:50 pm) and describes the 2016 founding 'for women of all experience levels'; the page also mentions the 2026 renewal and the closed 2026 Hot Hundred registration (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The home page states the weekly schedule; ride-by-ride details are in the club GroupMe. Re-read the page each fall for the winter start time.

name: Super Sunday Ride (CAMP)

visitor_notes: The shop's listing gives no distance, pace or skill level. CAMP's own site was behind a bot wall, so check it before driving out.
description: A Sunday afternoon mountain bike ride at Chewacla State Park run by Central Alabama Mountain Pedalers. The area shop lists it every Sunday in September 2026 at 4 pm. CAMP also runs a Tuesday 5:30 pm Ride and Grill that this listing doesn't place.
evidence: Trek Bicycle Auburn's events page lists 'Super Sunday Ride (CAMP) Chewacla State Park 4:00 p.m. CST' for Sept 6, 13, 20 and 27, 2026 (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

name: Pro Cycle Saturday Morning Ride
schedule: Every Saturday year-round, 7:30 am, from Pro Cycle Fairhope. 28 miles.
pace: About 18 mph for the first 15 miles, then whatever pace you choose
visitor_notes: Sign the shop's ride waiver before your first ride; it stays on file. Be able to hold about 18 mph. Tell the leader which group you are in. Arrive early to get ready.
description: The shop's year-round Saturday road ride. The first 15 or so miles run around 18 mph and the leader tries to keep the group together until it naturally splits. After that you ride your own pace. The shop calls it a drop ride but says it tries to make sure nobody is dropped if you say so.
evidence: Pro Cycle Fairhope's rides page states 'Saturday Morning Ride (Year Round) 7:30 am 28 Miles' as a weekly shop ride; nothing on the page is dated, but Mobile Bay Riders' 2026 club page links to the shop's rides (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The page has no dates. Check the shop's Strava club or call before a first visit; the Thursday and Tuesday evening rides are seasonal (spring and summer).

start_location.name: Varies; posted on the club's Facebook pages
